originality.rationale: The closest full-text Černý rank-profile result only proves 3s-2 through half rank and explicitly leaves larger deficiencies open. The claimed target s=n/2+1 is not a special case or dual reformulation of that covered domain. Exact k-avoidance maximizes over sets, while deficiency minimizes over images. Published general/minimal rank results do not logically imply this exact threshold without new boundary analysis. Index/literature searches and accessible own claims found no equivalent.
